dispositions.topic_text: Required test coverage for fresh sandbox namespaces, process isolation, code, and inputs
dispositions.what: A03-1: a check that inspects each execution from outside and asserts fresh user, PID, IPC and UTS namespaces and that the environment holds exactly the stdlib runtime, the code, the inputs, the exchange directory and its own processes, not only the exchange directory, mounts and network

dispositions.topic_text: Required test proving that ProofResult records are never persisted
dispositions.what: A05-6: a check that proving a flow version writes no ProofResult record to the store (store dump before and after proving is equal), not only that the proof is recomputed after a binding changes

dispositions.topic_text: Required test coverage for permitted local-development and loopback HTTP cases
dispositions.what: A09-3: a check that a plain http target is sent for a local_dev instance, for a disposable_rig instance and for a loopback host of any class, beside the existing refusal of production http to a non-loopback host
